findings.claim: The published evidence manifest can claim an arbitrary source commit without proving that commit contains the allowlisted source bytes.
findings.evidence: The generator trusts asset.sourceSha verbatim and checks only current filesystem bytes against sourceSha256; flint-realtime-contract.svg uses that override.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve the claimed commit and source path with Git, hash that blob, require it to equal sourceSha256, and reject source SHAs that do not contain the exact source bytes.

findings.claim: Local browser certification can silently run against a stale documentation server instead of the build under review.
findings.evidence: reuseExistingServer is true, so a process already answering on port 4177 can bypass the configured built-site server.
findings.suggested_fix: Disable server reuse for certification runs or require a build-specific fingerprint.
